fieldValues.title: Budget
fieldValues.article_text: At most 10 PRs merged per cycle. The Builder also stops when merged plus open group PRs reach 10 and labels the issue needs-input. Going over budget is an escalation.
fieldValues.rationale: A cap keeps the output reviewable (reviewable units over throughput).
fieldValues.amendment_rule: Owner only: an amendment needs a new owner-ratified decision.
fieldValues.protected_status: Agent testimony until the owner ratifies the charter decision.
